text:
mika: Quick thread, need a compact battlecard + two bench hooks for next week's webinar. Audience: SDRs + webinar attendees evaluating cloud-managed endpoints and LLM APIs. Keep language punchy, no heavy infra jargon.

oliver: Two micro-goals: 1) 3 one-line SDR opens; 2) two defendable bench claims (cost-first and latency-first) with one-sentence methodology notes.

mika: Draft SDR opens: "Seeing surprise inference bills? 10min to show a fix?" "Want SLA-backed p99s without model migration?" "Curious how serving can cut your per-token spend?" Thoughts?

nida: Love them. Add a micro-rebuttal pack for "we already use vendor X": A) "Sizing increases cost and still misses tails." B) "We layer on your model choices 0 no rip-and-replace." C) "Reserve vs burst economics explained in 2 bullets."

samir: Bench claims: cost-first = "~30% lower token spend on batch generation via continuous batching + quantization (8k traces)"; latency-first = "p99 reduced from ~1.1s to ~360ms using smart routing + prefix KV cache (5k traces)", will add methodology notes.

kate: For the webinar hook: open with a 2-sentence customer vignette (retail app spiked on peak). Show 2 visuals: cost-over-time and p99 waterfall. CTA: "Book a 15-min tail review for your app."

mika: Good. Oliver, can you make the A/B subject lines for the invite? Keep subject length <60 chars.

oliver: Options: A) "Stop surprise inference bills \u2014 15min demo" B) "Predictable p99s: live tail-trace demo". I'll queue both for a 3-day test.

cmp-bot: upload: https://drive.redwood/bench/4219990001/trace_sample.csv (auto)

samir: Method notes to include with bench claims: cost-first = 8k synthetic and real hybrid traces, injected peak windows, continuous batching vs naive endpoint; latency-first = 5k real chat traces, measured p95/p99 across routing policies. Add confidence intervals in the brief.

nida: SDR playbook: give them 3 opens + 3 rapid replies to objections. Example reply to "we scale with cloud": "Scaling up is expensive; we reduce unit cost and protect tails without moving models."

mika: Also add a 1-line operational lift row for the battlecard: "Cloud: low friction to start, ops grow; Redwood: small setup, predictable ops and cost governance." Keep it one line.

oliver: For the bench visuals: I'll do a single slide with two panels: left = cost delta by routing (hosted/dedicated/private), right = p99 before/after. Need CSV converted by analytics. ETA Tues noon.

samir: I'll prepare the two bench narrative docs and drop them in /marketing/bench-briefs tonight with raw numbers and CI. Links will be added to the deck notes.

kate: Quick SDR test: I'll run a 6-minute roleplay with two SDRs Thursday morning and report top 2 lines that land.

mika: Timeline: Oliver builds A/B + slides by Tue, Samir drops bench notes by tonight, Kate runs playtest Thu AM, final battlecard + SDR script Fri EOD.

cmp-bot: reminder: Webinar narrative sync scheduled Thu 11:00am PT (calendar invite sent).

mika: Thanks team. If anyone hears a specific competitor line (eg. "we have broader model choices"), post it here and well craft a neutral, serving-first response. Wrap for now. :sparkles:
